title: Custodial index switch

schema.script: a chain of DUP <index> EQUAL IF DROP <branch> ELSE, then one final branch and the matching ENDIFs
branches: two key hashes checked by a shared tail

note: A witness item picks which pair of key hashes can spend. One script uses one branch form, not both. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.
